title: Swap French-English columns
brief: A translation file lists French first, then English. Swap the two tab-separated columns on every line so English comes first.
text:
bonjour	hello
au revoir	goodbye
merci	thank you

expect.text:
hello	bonjour
goodbye	au revoir
thank you	merci

why: Using capture groups in a global substitute swaps the columns on every line in one pass.
author: claude (daily)
hint: Capture both sides of the tab and reverse their order in the replacement.
